name: Respite
source:
Cantor Yagon is in a rut.  Having long since failed to fulfill the responsibilities he's been saddled with as an emissary to the mage's guild of a cold and faraway land, he can't find much point in the doldrums of day to day life.

And so, he whiles away the time, seeking solace in the fleeting company of other queer men long after the sun's gone down. This is the story of one such ordinary night, where Cantor stumbles across a fellow lost soul.

[From [url=https://chmron.itch.io/respite]itch.io[/url]]

A prequel to Solstice Eve, detailing how its two leads meet.
translation:
坎托·亚贡的生活正深陷泥沼、停滞不前。作为派驻苦寒远邦法师公会的特使，他早已未能履行肩头背负的职责，在这死水般沉闷的日常里也再难寻得几分意义。

于是他只得浑浑噩噩地消磨时光，待夜色深沉之后，在与其他酷儿男性的露水相伴中寻求慰藉。这便是某个再寻常不过的夜晚所发生的故事——那一夜，坎托偶然邂逅了另一个同样迷失的灵魂。

[摘自[url=https://chmron.itch.io/respite]itch.io[/url]]

本作为《Solstice Eve》的前传，细述了两位男主角初遇的经过。
